metadata.zonesApply: R1, R2, R3, R4, RU5 (cl 3.1(3)(a), min lot area 200m2, min width 6m at building line)
metadata.note: Earlier assumption that setbacks sit in cl 3.10/3.11 confirmed: cl 3.10 = minimum setbacks and maximum height and length of boundary walls; cl 3.11 = exceptions to setbacks.

front.note: Not less than the average primary road setback of the 2 nearest dwelling houses on the same side of the road (excl. battle-axe lots, other-lot attached/detached development, articulation-zone elements). If fewer than 2 dwellings within 40m, use bands.

garage.note: Garage/carport attached to dwelling is covered by the dwelling front/secondary rules; side and rear apply expressly to a carport or garage (cl 3.10(4)(b), (10)(b)). No separate garage-behind-line rule in cl 3.10.
